stories.title: Spaanse politie stuit op martelkamer en redt twee mannen

en.title: Spanish police discover torture chamber and rescue two men
en.summary: Spanish police discovered a torture chamber in a villa in southern Spain and rescued two people who were being held there. Officers were alerted after a concerned woman called about her acquaintance who had gone to the address and stopped communicating.

stories.title: Nederland gaat tóch naar het Songfestival, maar hoe precies weet niemand

en.title: Netherlands will compete at Eurovision after all, but details remain unclear
en.summary: The Dutch public broadcaster NPO confirmed the Netherlands will send a Dutch artist to Eurovision in 2027 in Bulgaria. Questions remain about how the candidate selection process will be conducted.

stories.title: Eerste Kamerlid van FVD was bij extreemrechts protest op Malieveld

en.title: First Senate member of FVD attended far-right protest on Malieveld
en.summary: An FVD senator attended an extreme-right demonstration in The Hague on Saturday, contradicting the party's earlier statement that it did not support the protest. Another FVD member had previously withdrawn from attending for this reason.

stories.title: Meta verwijderde satirische video van Roel Maalderink over de Meta-videobrillen: 'Het laat zien hoe machtig zulke platformen zijn'

en.title: Meta removed satirical video by Roel Maalderink about Meta video glasses: 'It shows how powerful such platforms are'
en.summary: Meta deleted a satirical video about the company's AI glasses that was posted on Instagram by programmer Roel Maalderink within a day. An academic expert criticized the removal as deeply problematic.

stories.title: Baas van bijtgrage hond mogelijk op cursus én riskeert hogere straf bij incident

en.title: Owner of aggressive dog may face mandatory training course and higher penalties if incident occurs
en.summary: Owners of dogs prone to biting will be required to complete a practical training course, according to a letter from the Dutch Secretary of State for Agriculture, addressing dogs frequently associated with biting incidents.

stories.title: Nederland weer naar Songfestival: ‘Een artiest vinden die hier zijn vingers aan wil branden wordt moeilijk’

en.title: Netherlands returns to Eurovision: 'Finding an artist willing to take the risk will be difficult'
en.summary: The Netherlands will participate in the Eurovision Song Contest again, though securing an artist for the competition may prove challenging.

stories.title: Justitieminister Van Weel wacht spannend debat over onbehandelde aangiften

en.title: Justice Minister Van Weel faces tense debate over unprocessed criminal reports
en.summary: Justice Minister David van Weel will be questioned in parliament about how he handled information regarding unprocessed criminal reports, following allegations that parliament was misled.

stories.title: Verslaggevers van CNN, Politico en MS NOW geweigerd bij Witte Huis, ondanks uitspraak rechter

en.title: Reporters from CNN, Politico and MS NOW denied access to White House despite court ruling
en.summary: News outlets CNN, Politico and MS NOW had their journalists barred from the White House, contradicting a court decision issued hours earlier that had ruled against such a ban.

stories.title: Trump negeert vonnis: journalisten van Politico, CNN en MS NOW toegang geweigerd tot Witte Huis

en.title: Trump ignores ruling: journalists from Politico, CNN and MS NOW denied access to White House
en.summary: Journalists from Politico, CNN, and MS NOW were denied entry to the White House despite a court order requiring their access be restored.

stories.title: Witte Huis blijft journalisten weigeren, dus geen live beeld van Xi-Trump

en.title: White House continues denying journalists access, resulting in no live coverage of Xi-Trump meeting
en.summary: Reporters from Politico, CNN, and MS NOW were refused entry to the White House in violation of a court order, preventing live coverage of a meeting between Xi and Trump.

stories.title: EU heeft opties om het Internationaal Strafhof te beschermen tegen meer sancties van de VS – is ze bereid die in te zetten?

en.title: EU has options to protect the International Criminal Court against further US sanctions – is it willing to use them?
en.summary: The Trump administration plans additional sanctions against the International Criminal Court in The Hague, but the EU possesses tools to protect the court if it chooses to deploy them.

stories.title: Trump moet verbannen media CNN, MS NOW en Politico weer toelaten tot Witte Huis, oordeelt rechter

en.title: Judge orders Trump to readmit banned media CNN, MS NOW and Politico to White House
en.summary: A federal judge ruled that CNN, MS NOW and Politico must regain access to the White House after President Trump revoked their press credentials. The judge found that proper procedures were not followed in removing the journalists' accreditation.
